essence: The ritual base is visualized as resting on earth, Śeṣa, the milk-ocean, the frog, and the deity-tree
Protective weapons are declared to be placed outside the earth-enclosure
The hostile rite is performed in a cremation ground within the tortoise-circle according to the enemy's name group
The practitioner should make an effigy from mustard seed combined with dust from the enemy
The left-then-right sequence is reversed when the target is a woman
